title: About Me
subtitle: WordPress Developer & Web Specialist
bio: I'm Yousri, a passionate WordPress developer with over 5 years of hands-on experience building and managing websites. My expertise goes beyond just WordPress development — I have deep knowledge in domain management, VPS server configuration, and hosting optimization that allows me to deliver complete web solutions.
bio2: I believe in clean code, performance optimization, and creating websites that not only look great but also perform exceptionally. Whether it's setting up a fresh VPS, configuring DNS records, or building a complex WordPress theme from scratch, I handle every aspect of web development with precision.
